messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The reporting service is owned by team Dune. [valid 2025-01-20 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]

    earlier: As of 2025-09-05, team Dune still owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-05]
- As of 2025-06-25, the job scheduler is owned by team Dune. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-scheduler]
    earlier: The job scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- As of 2026-03-09, feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team; the 2026-02-11 handover note that said team Dune was written against the wrong team, and Dune never owned it. [decision; valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
- On 2026-04-14, team Dune noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-2]
- The team Dune planning meeting is every Wednesday. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22-4]

    earlier: As of 2026-03-11, Tomasz holds the Dune on-call shift for team Dune, taking over from Farah; as of 2026-01-16 Farah held it. [decision; valid 2026-03-11 to 2026-04-14; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-11]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-16, Farah Haddad holds the Dune on-call shift for team Dune; Tomasz is off rotation. [decision; valid 2026-01-16 to 2026-03-11; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-16]
    earlier: As of 2025-12-10, Tomasz holds the Dune on-call shift for team Dune, having taken over from Farah. [valid 2025-12-10 to 2026-01-16; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-10]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-17, Farah still holds the Dune on-call shift for team Dune, having taken over from Tomasz. [valid 2025-11-17 to 2025-12-10; recorded by standup/dune/2025-11-17]
    earlier: As of 2025-10-15, Farah holds the Dune on-call shift for team Dune, having taken over from Tomasz. [valid 2025-10-15 to 2025-11-17; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-15]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-04, Tomasz holds the Dune on-call shift, having picked it up from Farah. [valid 2025-09-04 to 2025-10-15; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-04]
- Farah runs team Dune solo until the next hire lands. [valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-09]
- As of 2026-05-22, Tomasz holds the Dune on-call shift for team Dune, taking over from Farah. [decision; valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22]
- Team Dune adopted a monthly game day. [valid 2025-04-21 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-21]
- Farah takes the first on-call rotation for team Dune. [decision; valid 2025-01-13 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-13]
- Farah was the primary on-call for team Dune until 2026-03-11, when Tomasz took over the pager; on 2026-04-14 Tomasz handed the pager back to Farah. [decision; valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14]
    earlier: Farah was the primary on-call for team Dune until 2026-03-11, when Tomasz took over the pager. [decision; valid 2026-03-11 to 2026-04-14; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-11]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-16, Farah Haddad is the primary on-call for team Dune. [decision; valid 2026-01-16 to 2026-03-11; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-16]
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]

Question: Which team owned reporting before Dune?
